description: This is a Dart source file defining an AuthProvider class that manages user authentication state, including login, registration, logout, and initialization from stored data in a Flutter application.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing authentication state, including user info, loading status, and methods for login, registration, bootstrap, and logout.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Restores user data from storage if available and notifies listeners.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login via API, stores auth info on success, updates loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs user registration via API, stores auth info on success, updates loading state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, clears stored auth data, and notifies listeners.
